content.value: Python uses logical operators such as and, or, and not to combine or invert boolean expressions.

concepts.name: and
concepts.description: A logical operator that is true only when both connected conditions are true.

concepts.name: or
concepts.description: A logical operator that is true when at least one connected condition is true.

concepts.name: not
concepts.description: A logical operator that reverses the truth value of a condition.

concepts.name: Comparison operator
concepts.description: An operator such as ==, !=, <, or > that compares values and returns a Boolean result.

concepts.name: Truth value
concepts.description: Whether a value or expression is treated as true or false in a Boolean context.

concepts.name: Compound condition
concepts.description: A condition made by combining multiple Boolean expressions with logical operators.
